# Compile regression corpus

Real-world documents that must compile in the sandbox (`TestSandboxCorpus`, build tag `sandbox`,
`make test-compile-sandbox`; CI's `Compile sandbox (TeX Live)` job). All names, addresses,
phone numbers, links and references are made up.

| Folder | What it exercises |
| --- | --- |
| `cv` | A RenderCV-style CV: fontawesome5, paracol, eso-pic, lmodern, hyperref, bookmark, lastpage, `\input{glyphtounicode}` |
| `paper` | `filecontents` writing `refs.bib`, BibTeX, TikZ, maths, a table, cross-references |
| `beamer` | A beamer deck: theme, overlays, columns, a block, TikZ |
| `figures` | A PNG and a PDF figure in a subfolder (`\graphicspath`) |
| `biblatex` | biblatex with the biber backend (biber runs from its copy unpacked into the image) |
| `metafont` | A METAFONT-only font (bbm), generated by mktexpk into `/tmp/texmf-var` |

To see what a document touches in the sandbox, run `make compile-trace dir=<folder>`.
